name: p3-source_walk_baseline
text: struct S { int a; int b; }; {{FORM}}

FORM.direct_parameter: int far f(int far *source, int n) { int i; int sum; sum = 0; if (source == 0) return 0; for (i = 0; i < n; ++i) sum += source[i]; return sum; }
FORM.local_alias: int far f(int far *source, int n) { int i; int sum; int far *p; sum = 0; p = source; if (p == 0) return 0; for (i = 0; i < n; ++i) sum += p[i]; return sum; }
FORM.macro_alias:
#define SOURCE source
int far f(int far *source, int n) { int i; int sum; sum = 0; if (SOURCE == 0) return 0; for (i = 0; i < n; ++i) sum += SOURCE[i]; return sum; }
